LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 7.3.1 TENSE: FUTURE TIME USING WILL/SHALL

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.3: Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Tense: Future Time using will/shall

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Tense: Future Time using will/shall. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: which feature will and shall. 1. Which words do we use to show future time?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify words that indicate future time using will and shall in sentences
2. use will and shall to express future time correctly

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

• Today’s maths focus is Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Tense: Future Time using will/shall.

• Start with objects you can touch or draw — stones, sticks, bottle tops, or drawings in your book.

• Say the steps aloud as you work so you do not skip a stage.

• Check your answer with a second method or by estimating.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At the market, count 10 mangoes and put them in 2 groups of 5.

Example 2: In class, count the desks in your row and write the number in figures and in words.

Example 3: If you have 7 shillings and receive 5 more, you have 12 shillings.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Solve three short problems about Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Tense: Future Time using will/shall using drawings.
2. Explain one solution to a partner in your own words.
3. Make up one new word problem set in your county or school.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five practice questions and solve them in your book.
2. Show your working clearly — not only the final answer.
3. Teach a younger learner one idea from this lesson with bottle tops or drawings.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Answer questions on future time using will/shall collaboratively,
2. Construct sentences using will/shall collaboratively,
3. Role play activities they plan or wish to do in future with peers,
4. Use computers, tablets or mobile phones to listen to audio materials featuring future time,
5. Make predictions (on events, weather, among others) using will and shall,

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. which feature will and shall. 1. Which words do we use to show future time?
2. How do you tell that something will happen in the future?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Use objects or drawings when a sum feels hard.
2. Check every answer.
3. Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Tense: Future Time using will/shall is used in real Kenyan life — market, school, and home.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
